text: Amnesty International's 2016 investigation of palm-oil plantations in Indonesia documented child and forced labour, and traced palm oil to nine companies including Procter & Gamble; it said P&G is highly likely to be supplied by the plantations it investigated.

source.name: Amnesty International USA – The great palm oil scandal: Labor abuses behind big brand names
source.quote: Unilever, Nestlé, Proctor & Gamble among nine household names contributing to labor abuse

additionalSources.name: Deutsche Welle – Report: Multinationals profiting from child labor
additionalSources.quote: An Amnesty report released Wednesday says Unilever, Nestle and Procter & Gamble are among nine household names contributing to abuse including child and forced labor.
